Council Meetings and Reports

Hay Shire Council meets on the fourth Tuesday of each month, commencing at 1.00pm (however this may change due to circumstances on rare occasions). Members of the public are welcome to attend the ordinary meetings of Council which are held in the Council Chambers, 134 Lachlan Street, Hay.

General Council business dealt with at Council meetings are open to the public, however, confidential matters are closed to the public.

More information about Council meetings is available from Council staff on (02) 6990 1100 during business hours.
